name: claim-free-games
description: Automatically claim Epic Games Store giveaways with an API-first strategy and browser fallback.

scripts.claim: npm run build --silent && node dist/src/index.js run
scripts.auth: npm run build --silent && node dist/src/index.js auth
scripts.doctor: npm run build --silent && node dist/src/index.js doctor
scripts.notify-test: npm run build --silent && node dist/src/index.js notify-test
scripts.assist-test: npm run build --silent && node dist/src/index.js assist-test
scripts.desktop:dev: npm run build && npm run build:desktop && electron .
scripts.desktop:dist: npm run build && npm run build:desktop && electron-builder
